Alpha Zombies are powerful mutated zombies with especially high life and unique abilities. Alpha zombies must first be formed inside a cocoon, and if not killed they will hatch to fight alongside the horde. So far 5 types of alpha zombies have been identified:<n/><n/><c val="0000FF">Aberration:</c> serves as a tank with extremely high life and powerful attacks<n/><c val="8000FF">Geneweaver:</c> summons evolved forms of zombies to add to the horde, vulnerable while taking damage<n/><c val="00FF00">Anubalisk:</c> strikes with subterranean spines to slowly kill its enemies from far away<n/><c val="FF0000">Legion Zombie:</c> provides buffs to nearby zombies, strengthening the horde, also spreads creep wherever it goes<n/><c val="FF8000">Hunter:</c> Moves quickly on creep and inflicts poison with attacks, also can blind players<n/><c val="FFFF00">Oculus:</c> flying zombie that can scout its enemies, its evolved form can launch micro parasites which weaken opponents<n/><c val="000000">???:</c> more to come in the future

Maintenance shafts can be used to travel to the facility sub-level with the 'interact' ability. Zombies cannot access the sub-level, allowing safer travel between points. Unfortunately, the sub-level is extremely pressurized. Your suit's pressure resistence system will slowly drain energy at first, but once energy is drained you will begin taking damage. The pressure also slows down movement in the sub-level.
